Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.5: Good behaviour during mealtimes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Good behaviour during mealtimes. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Good behaviour during mealtimes.
2. Explain Good behaviour during mealtimes to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Good behaviour during mealtimes.
4. Show that you can: name appropriate behaviour ( 2 lessons) be observed during mealtimes,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Good behaviour during mealtimes. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: why it is important to mealtimes?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
